code: cfg <- gk_example_config() cells <- gk_simulate(n_cells = 300L, seed = 7L) prep <- gk_prepare(cells, config = cfg, quiet = TRUE) corrected <- gk_correct(prep, method = "robust_z") thresholds <- gk_thresholds(prep, cfg, correction = corrected, seed = 7L) classification <- gk_classify(prep, thresholds, config = cfg, correction = corrected) #> Warning: 4 hierarchy rules disabled because required markers are not #> callable. states <- gk_state_calls(prep, thresholds, classification, config = cfg) structures <- gk_structures(classification, prep) review <- gk_review(classification, states, structures, thresholds, prep) reviewed <- gk_replay(review)  snapshot <- gk_lock(review, reviewer = "example-reviewer", status = "PENDING") export_dir <- tempfile("gatekeepR-example-") gk_export(snapshot, dir = export_dir) stopifnot(all(gk_verify_export(export_dir,   expected_review_id = snapshot$review_id_full)$ok))
